card.text: The hottest planet, hidden beneath thick clouds.

introduction.text: Venus is the second planet from the Sun. It spins backward, and one day there lasts longer than its year.

clouds.title: Cloud illustration
clouds.summary: An OpenSpace cloud texture of unknown camera, wavelength and processing.

radar.title: C3-MDIR synthetic-color radar mosaic
radar.summary: Radar images of the ground beneath the clouds, in added colors a person would not see.

elevation.title: Height of the solid surface
elevation.summary: Radar measurements reveal Venus’s plains and mountains beneath the clouds; colors show height above a reference sphere.

ultraviolet.title: Akatsuki ultraviolet photograph
ultraviolet.summary: Venus in ultraviolet light from orbit on 30 August 2023. Grey marks the half the camera could not see.

emissivity.title: How efficiently the surface emits
emissivity.summary: Warm ground gives off microwaves; emissivity measures how efficiently it does so compared with an ideal emitter.

reflectivity.title: How strongly the surface reflects
reflectivity.summary: Magellan sent radar through the clouds; this map estimates how reflective the ground is at that wavelength.

roughness.title: Small-scale bumps seen by radar
roughness.summary: Radar echoes reveal how uneven the ground is at scales of meters; larger values mean a rougher surface.
